[[Mina Shatter Storm]] is an [[Am Fah]] [[Mesmer]] [[boss]] that appears in [[The Undercity]].

* [[Bolt of Cloth]]

== Notes ==
* Before you [[aggro]] his group, he's clapping and laughing at three female [[Canthan Peasant]]s, dancing for their Am Fah oppressors.
* He will not [[spawn]] after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her during [[Chasing Zenmai]].

== Trivia ==
* Mina Shatter Storm is briefly described on the [[Jade Brotherhood]]'s [[Most Wanted Am Fah 4|Most Wanted Am Fah #4]] plaque during the [[Deactivating P.O.X.]] quest.
